instruction.text: Read the definition and choose the picture that matches the description.

atoms.a: A horizontal line is a line that goes straight across from left to right or right to left.
A vertical line is a line that goes straight up and down with the top directly above the bottom.

b: The picture shows two vertical lines.
The picture shows two lines that are neither horizontal nor vertical.
atoms.finishSound: The picture shows two horizontal lines.

text: The purple line and the pink line are both horizontal.

b: The blue line is neither horizontal nor vertical.
++The yellow line is neither horizontal nor vertical.
atoms.finishSound: The yellow line is neither horizontal nor vertical.

text: The yellow line is not horizontal and not vertical.

text: The yellow line and the green line are both vertical. And the purple line and the pink line are neither horizontal nor vertical.
